articles.text: José introduces Colonel Harris to his fiancée, Carmen Del Valle. The Colonel arrived from the United States on Monday and will work with the embassy. Carmen asks if he will be staying long, and he replies that he will, since he will be working with the embassy. They discuss the arrival of the Colonel’s family and the fact that the airport is about half an hour away by car.

Later, Carmen asks if the Colonel came with his family. He says no – his wife, three children and mother‑in‑law arrive tomorrow – so he will have to rent a house. They talk about how houses in the Bellavista section are beautiful and inexpensive, and the Colonel plans to discuss it with his wife.
